findings.text: The document says it records the pre-refactor targets at baseline `3e2212ed`, but the row now presents `ControlRules.lean` with `runScriptStep_begin_eq` and `runScriptStep_commit_eq` as those targets, with no date and without the four original names. Fix: keep `runScriptStep_begin_idle`, `runScriptStep_begin_active`, `runScriptStep_commit_active` and `runScriptStep_commit_idle` as the recorded targets and add a note dated 2026-11-24 that ADR 0033 slice 3 replaced them by the two exact rules in `ControlRules.lean`.

The row replaces the listed retained declarations and the dated note "2026-11-23" with undated present-tense text ("now derives", "still have specialized sends at slice 3"), so a pre-refactor inventory presents a changed decision without its date and loses its ids. Fix: keep the declaration names and the 2026-11-23 note, and add a note dated 2026-11-24 that slice 3 replaced `Sql.check_send_setting`, `Sql.check_send_begin` and `Sql.check_send_commit` by `Sql.check_send_of_rule`, while `Sql.check_send_dropPlain` and `Sql.check_send_rewrite` remain.
